history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration call upon the related governing bodies to ensure that all efficiency gains achieved from the bilateral and inter-entity initiatives, including common back offices and common premises, are fully and duly captured and reported.
history.administration_response: Communication and reporting on all efficiency gains achieved is a critical pillar of the efficiency agenda. To that objective, the report of the Secretary- General on the quadrennial comprehensive policy review of operational activities for development of the United Nations system, which is usually presented to the Economic and Social Council in April each year, includes specific information on efficiency gains relating to the four pillars. They include agency initiatives, global shared services, common back offices, business operations strategies and common premises. In addition, the efficiency dashboard launched in August 2023 reports the efficiency gains for all those specific areas. Currently, the data for 2022 have been fully captured and reported. As at the present time, data for 2023 are being finalized and when officially approved, will be released through the 2023 version of the efficiency dashboard. The efficiency dashboard is accessible. The Development Coordination Office requests the Board to close this recommendation.
history.board_assessment: Given that the efficiency dashboard has been launched, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
